summary: Frontend-only E2E browser testing of OfficeFlowV5 preview deployment. Verified /login rendering, admin login (admin@example.com/admin123) redirect to /dashboard, dashboard data loading from backend, Employees page list, session persistence after reload, and invalid-credential error handling. All 4 requested flows PASS. Zero console errors and zero CORS errors; all /api/* XHRs returned 200 on same origin via relative /api baseURL.

integration_issues.issue: Console warning on every dashboard load: WebSocket connection to 'wss://<host>/api/ws/dispatch' failed: WebSocket is closed before the connection is established. Non-blocking (page renders fine) but realtime dispatch updates will not work in preview; likely ingress/WS proxy not enabled for /api/ws. Verify backend WS route is mounted and add reconnect/graceful-degrade handling.

Dashboard 'Total Employees' shows 0 while /api/employees returns 1 record (Super Admin) rendered on Employees page. /api/admin/dashboard-stats likely excludes admin/super_admin roles - confirm this is intended, otherwise counts are inconsistent.

action_items: Confirm/enable WebSocket proxying for /api/ws/dispatch or suppress the repeated failed-connection warning with graceful fallback
Confirm intended behaviour of dashboard Total Employees = 0 vs 1 employee listed on Employees page
critical_code_review_comments: authStore.login sets isAuthenticated without resetting isLoading; ProtectedRoute relies on checkAuth so this is currently harmless but is fragile.
Dashboard issues duplicate polling calls (presence/heartbeat, gps/active, notifications, employee-status fired twice per cycle) - likely double-mounted effects (StrictMode) causing 2x backend load.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend E2E verified: login page render, login+redirect to /dashboard, dashboard stats/live status render, /dashboard/employees list, session persistence across reload, invalid password shows 'Invalid email or password' via [data-testid=login-error-message]. All API calls same-origin relative /api, all 200s. Remaining untested areas: Shifts, Attendance, Live Map, Leaves, Payroll, Reports, Settings, and all Dispatch module pages; also CRUD (Add Employee modal) not exercised. Known open item: /api/ws/dispatch websocket fails in preview.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no blocking issues. WS warning root cause: wss upgrade to /api/ws/dispatch is closed before establishment, consistent with ingress not forwarding WebSocket upgrade for the /api path in the preview environment.
